models_evaluated: LLM (GPT-4 class; model not specified in text)

links.outcome: Diagnostic reasoning score for physicians with vs without LLM access, plus LLM alone comparison
links.effect: Physician+LLM 71.4% vs 42.6% conventional resources; adjusted difference 27.5 pp (95% CI 22.8 to 32.2). LLM alone outperformed physician+LLM by 11.5 pp.
links.quote: Of 58 physicians completing the study, those with LLM access achieved mean diagnostic reasoning scores of 71.4% versus 42.6% with conventional medical resources alone, yielding an adjusted difference of 27.5 percentage points (95% CI, 22.8 to 32.2; P < 0.001).

links.outcome: Human-AI team diagnostic reasoning versus physicians alone and LLM alone
links.effect: Physician+LLM 71.4% vs 42.6% without LLM; LLM alone exceeded trained physicians by 11.5 pp; in 38% of cases physician+LLM surpassed median LLM-alone.
links.quote: While LLM alone outperformed the trained physician group by 11.5 percentage points (95% CI, 5.5 to 17.5; P < 0.001), in 38% of cases the physician plus LLM group surpassed the median LLM-alone performance, highlighting physician-AI complementarities.
